name: Shin Koihime † Musou -Kakumei- Ryuuki no Taimou
original_name: 真・恋姫†夢想-革命- 劉旗の大望
source:
This is the third and last game in BaseSon’s Koihime -Kakumei- series, expanding on the events from Shin Koihime†Musou and focusing on the Shoku faction. It has truly come full circle back to Kazuto’s first meeting with Touka, Aisha and Rinrin. There’s 34 heroines that you can pursue (up from 23 in the original).

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/07/05/july-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是BaseSon《恋姬-革命-》系列的第三部、也是最后一部作品，扩展了《真·恋姬†无双》的剧情，并聚焦蜀国阵营。故事回到了Kazuto最初与桃香、爱莎和铃铃相遇的时刻，真正形成了完整的循环。可攻略女主角共有34人，比原作的23人更多。

（来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/07/05/july-2019-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]）
